reviewType: Read-only source/compiled-input contract review; no Node/project/native execution.
conditions: Create and validate a new author package; do not edit an existing installed manifest in place.
Install through normal immutable package validation and give explicit current-project grants to both handoff participants.
Re-run the new browser/package scenario after parent JS/UI freeze and HTTP safe-error/manifest patches.
No tool/action/backend admission or model/target authority is added by ui.handoff.

sourceEvidence.claim: Permissions are finite/unique/valid. Every tool/action must reference a declaration; no reverse requirement makes every declared permission a tool/action permission. Runtime manifest bytes determine descriptor hash.

if m.schema_version != 2
            || m.host_api != "^2.0.0"
            || !app_id(&m.id)
            || !version(&m.version)
            || m.data_schema_version == 0
            || m.data_schema_version > MAX_SAFE_INTEGER as u64
            || m.runtime.kind != "native"
            || !matches!(m.runtime.platform.as_str(), "linux" | "darwin" | "win32")
            || !matches!(m.runtime.arch.as_str(), "x64" | "arm64")
            || !package_path(&m.entry)
            || !m.entry.starts_with("bin/")
            || m.entry[4..].contains('/')
            || m.permissions.len() > 128
            || m.tools.len() > 64
            || m.actions.len() > 128
            || m.pages.len() > 16
            || m.files.len() > 512
            || !unique(m.permissions.iter().map(|p| p.id.clone()))
            || !unique(m.tools.iter().map(|p| p.name.clone()))
            || !unique(m.actions.iter().map(|p| p.name.clone()))
            || !unique(m.pages.iter().map(|p| p.id.clone()))
        {
            return Err("app_manifest_invalid".into());
        }
        for p in &m.permissions {
            if !permission_name(&p.id) || !metadata_text(&p.description, 1024) {
                return Err("app_manifest_invalid".into());
            }
        }
        for (spec, action) in m
            .tools
            .iter()
            .map(|s| (s, false))
            .chain(m.actions.iter().map(|s| (s, true)))
        {
            if !local_name(&spec.name)
                || !metadata_text(&spec.description, 2048)
                || !m.permissions.iter().any(|p| p.id == spec.permission)
                || spec.input_schema.get("type") != Some(&json!("object"))
                || (action && !matches!(spec.scope.as_deref(), Some("project" | "application")))
                || (spec.delivery.is_some()
                    && (!action
                        || spec.scope.as_deref() != Some("project")
                        || spec.input_schema != artifact_read_schema()))
            {
                return Err("app_manifest_invalid".into());
            }
            schema::validate(&spec.input_schema, action, 0).map_err(|_| "app_manifest_invalid")?;

sourceEvidence.claim: Each RPC resolves an actual declared tool/action then validates its permission; run_stdio reads the installed package manifest at startup, not a compiled-in permission inventory.
JS verifier uses the same one-way declaration/reference constraint and native permissions limit128.
Host starts the installed entry and compares describe manifestSha256 to current exact installed manifest bytes; unchanged binary can acknowledge a freshly built valid package.
Page handoff requires independently current source/target grants, page IDs, project and revision. Declaration does not grant business invocation.
Author packager copies explicit binary unchanged and generates a fresh normal manifest/package. No native compilation occurs.
ui.handoff is a permission-only declaration; no tool/action is added for it.
